title: Chapter 1441 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1441 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later (Part 2)

Chapter 1441 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later (Part 2)

"The Lord of Fire failed as well?"

"The Lord of Fire had reached the ultimate tier of the second level several hundred cataclysm cycles ago, just one calamity short of becoming a Legendary Lord. Even among second-tier ultimate lords, their accumulation is considered top-notch, yet they do not meet the 'special' requirements for entry into the deepest realm?"

"It's too difficult."

Lords around whispered, without a hint of schadenfreude.

"The Lord of Fire?"

Lin Yuan glanced at the figure expelled from the void passage, recalling that this lord was a formidable presence, even surpassing some Legendary Lords in certain aspects.

Legendary Lords of the third tier are engrossed in pursuing the path of transcendence, and in terms of reputation, might not necessarily surpass some second-tier ultimate lords.

"I will give it a try."

After the Lord of Fire was expelled, another lord stepped forward, entering the void passage with a single stride.

Only second-tier ultimate lords dare to try entering the void passage. As for those who have touched the threshold of legend? They don't even have the ability to attempt.

"In front of the void entrance, layers of time forces are spread out; basically, only second-tier ultimate lords can withstand them and thus attempt to enter the void passage."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, simultaneously abandoning the idea of trying to enter the void passage himself.

His true state isn't even at the lord level; his timeline hasn't consolidated, and he has no hope of withstanding the layers of time forces.

"But it's good to come here and witness it."

Lin Yuan wasn't very disappointed.

Before long.

The second-tier ultimate lord who entered after the Lord of Fire was also expelled.

"Exactly what kind of second-tier ultimate meets the requirements for entry?"

This lord furrowed their brow.

Lin Yuan also observed from afar.

At that moment—

The originally calm void entrance suddenly boiled.

This boiling far exceeded the ripples caused by the second-tier ultimate lord being expelled.

Soon after.

From behind the void entrance, figures exuding a terrifying aura emerged.

The leading figure radiated with a purple light, seemingly illuminating layers of time and space dimensions.

"Are they... Legendary Lords?"

"Legendary Lords!"

Logically, the Legendary Lords pondering in the deepest realm wouldn't come out so soon.

"Why have the Legendary Lords come out?"

The many Time Lords were somewhat bewildered.

The closing of the Wanwei dimension is still far off.

Logically, the Legendary Lords pondering in the deepest realm wouldn't come out so soon.

The purple-light Legendary Lord surveyed the surroundings, their gaze falling on Lin Yuan, smiling: "Little friend, are you planning to enter the deepest realm to ponder?"

The other Legendary Lords' gazes also fell on Lin Yuan.

Having seen a glimpse of Lin Yuan's future, these Legendary Lords had a consistent attitude towards him.

That was to keep a distance.

But now Lin Yuan was at the entrance of the deepest realm.

He had already shown interest in the deepest realm of Wanwei.

These Legendary Lords naturally couldn't sit idly by.

Keeping a distance doesn't mean no contact or exclusion.

Now that Lin Yuan had reached the entrance of the deepest realm, if they continued to ignore him.

In the future, when Lin Yuan becomes one of the strongest Legendary Lords across the vast dimensional planes, they would naturally reap no benefits.

Therefore, every Legendary Lord in the deepest realm came out to meet Lin Yuan.

Preparing to bring Lin Yuan into the deepest realm of Wanwei.

Besides the two methods above, there is another way to enter the deepest realm.

That is to be brought in by a Legendary Lord.

Similar to how a Time Lord can bring time beings into Wanwei.

But what kind of existence are Legendary Lords? Would they bring second-tier lords into the deepest realm without reason?

So this method wasn't considered.

"Enter the deepest realm to ponder?"

Lin Yuan looked at the Legendary Lords, whose eyes were filled with goodwill towards him, thoughts turning, and nodded directly: "Yes."

It was evident that these Legendary Lords probably sensed the disturbance when he summoned his future self.

That's why they had such an attitude.

Apart from this reason, Lin Yuan couldn't think of any other aspects that would cause the Legendary Lords to treat him so warmly.

In this situation.

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn't refuse.

He didn't actually plan to necessarily venture into the deepest region of the Wanwei space-time.

But if there's an opportunity to enter, Lin Yuan wouldn't refuse either.

"Young friend, come in with us." The Purple Light Legendary Lord said with a smile.

Then he raised his hand and forcibly opened a passage in the void entrance.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan immediately followed in.

Once Lin Yuan entered, the other Legendary Lords also followed suit one by one.

...

"What happened?"

Outside the void entrance, the Time Lords were stunned. They longed to enter the deepest region, yet Lin Yuan went in so easily? And he was welcomed by the Legendary Lords?

"Who is he?"

"Why does he receive such treatment from the Legendary Lords?"

Compared to Lin Yuan entering the deepest region, the attitude of the many Legendary Lords was even more bewildering.

A second-level Lord entering the deepest region isn't unheard of, but so many Legendary Lords personally coming out to welcome him is unprecedented.

"I remember now, he is 'Galaxy', recently in the deep region, his future self erased the Blood Sea Lord's future self before he could cross into the legendary level. In the future, this 'Galaxy' will be an incredibly powerful Legendary Lord."

A Time Lord said.

"So that's the case."

"An incredibly powerful Legendary Lord's past self?"

The Time Lords were enlightened; this somewhat explains the stance of the Legendary Lords.

"Legendary Lord, and an incredibly powerful Legendary Lord!"

The Time Lords marveled; if Galaxy's future was just a normal Legendary Lord, he wouldn't be personally welcomed by the Legendary Lords.

"Galaxy."

All the Time Lords remembered this name firmly in their hearts.

...

Wanwei space-time.

Deepest region.

This is a vast white world.

Seven or eight Legendary Lords followed beside Lin Yuan, introducing everything about the deepest region.

"That is the Origin Stone, which contains the experience of Lord Wanwei exploring the path of 'infinite origins', detailing the taboos of certain ancient time periods."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord pointed at an enormous divine stone.

"Origin Stone?"

Lin Yuan gazed at it from afar, faintly sensing scenes from a very ancient past.

"Past space-time is very dangerous, especially those involving terrifying beings from the past."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord sighed and said, "These terrifying beings fell due to being too close to transcendence, but in the past space-time, they left their marks. Exploring the path of 'infinite origins', exploring past space-time, there's a great chance of encountering traces left by these terrifying beings."

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Previously, he only knew the greatest danger of exploring the path of 'infinite origins' was the curse of being lost.

Now it seems, that's not all.

"In the deepest region, Lord Wanwei left two places: the Origin Stone is one, the other is the 'Abyss of Calamity'." The Purple Light Legendary Lord looked to the distance.

Lin Yuan followed his gaze, where a dark abyss lay.

"The Abyss of Calamity records the numerous calamities experienced by Lord Wanwei, as well as other collected calamities. Although the path of 'endless calamity' is different for each Lord, observing the calamities experienced by other Lords can provide reference value for oneself."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord said.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Expressing agreement.

The forms of calamities may differ, but essentially there are similar aspects.

...

Next.

Lin Yuan conversed with the various Legendary Lords.

Then he began to ponder over the mysteries on his own.

In the deepest region of Wanwei space-time, aside from comprehending the 'Origin Stone' and 'Abyss of Calamity'.

Moreover, Lin Yuan can also gain from Lord Wanwei's understanding of space-time, aiding his own consolidation of time lines and creation of the "Innate Five Great" in the future.

Time slowly passed.

In a blink, six thousand years had gone by.
